caseName: Duluth, Missabe & Iron Range Railway Co. v. Minnesota
caseNameFull: Duluth, Missabe & Iron Range Railway Co. v. Minnesota
attorneys: Donald D. Harries, Franklin B. Stevens and Vermont Hatch for appellant. Miles Lord, Attorney General, and Victor J. Miehaelson, Assistant Attorney General, for the State of Minnesota, and Gordon Rosenmeier for the Order of Railway Conductors et al., appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
